acceptance_assessment.basis: The full lower W string and exact nonzero lower A were compared directly with the original PHYS29 keys; both serialized J inputs match PHYS22 and the copied PHYS29 keys. The frozen source-real definition retains exact rational values of source binary64 literals and exact-real products. No zero level, upper level, rounded retained node, stored rounded prefactor or native operation order replaces this definition.

Directed endpoint arithmetic, exact Fraction-to-Decimal enclosure, four-product multiplication, zero-denominator rejection, exact copy sign/abs operations, and one-adjacent-value expansion of correctly rounded ln/exp/sqrt were statically reviewed. Positive-base real powers use exp(log(x)*alpha). No native float intermediate is silently substituted.

T[a,b] is the exact product rule; q_DD plus 6(1+z)q_D represents D^2+3D; ordinary energy exponents and multiplier update correctly. Exact affine/Bernstein identities cover entire cells. Maximum observed representation degree is 12.

Each of five derivative orders has 32 ordered contiguous exact rational cells, with endpoints equal to the archived z-domain. The containing energy range remains strictly between the source HI and HeI cutoffs. The complete feasible tube, packet supports and slope interpolation paths lie in J.

For the lower orientation D=x-e<0, the exact divided-difference identity still gives F_W=integral_0^1 t E_alpha[k_second(e+tD+delta Z)]dt. Thus kappa>0 uniformly. The separately checked W_hat>mu2 R d condition makes p_delta increasing; q_delta<=q0, the center displacement bound and the common smoothing bound give a uniform B. Adding the preserved epsilon_r gives a positive tube margin before invoking root existence. Continuity and strict monotonicity imply one root per profile per width inside the fixed tube, with displacement <=0.170563 eV^2.

The exact identity h_p-h_u=((1-z^2)^4)^(4)/768, four vanishing boundary terms and integral (1-z^2)^4 dz=256/315 give the positive Peano factor 1/945. Equal second moments preserve common geometry at the same actual W. Positive k_fourth and the positive mean root-segment slope imply the exact negative quartic root difference for every 0<delta<=0.001 eV. The reported C_small and C_large use outward endpoints of the original bound calculations; the short constants are not recombined to manufacture new margins.

Eight archived interval overlaps at retained b and u_zero compare orders 0,1,2,4 of two mathematical expressions. The independent ordinary-energy derivative formula is E^2 phi^(n+2)+(2n+4)E phi^(n+1)+n(n+3)phi^n. These expressions share the arithmetic backend and are supplemental to the continuous proof.

Both archived 1,028,560-byte scientific results are byte identical and contain PASS_SCOPED, 25/25 checks and failure=null. The first and replay process receipts have observed child returncode 0, timed_out=false, matching stdout hashes and empty stderr; stored exec tool outputs parse to those process receipts and exit_code is 0. The six packaged ledgers match the live ledger directory, and the 34-member replay ZIP matches the 33 frozen inputs plus the preexecution freeze. Counters agree with the static call graph and the frozen caps. The reviewer read archived evidence and did not relaunch either process.

The exact frozen J strings and source fit define a mathematical model, not physical uncertainty sets. No J/fit uncertainty propagation, coupled production history, NCP/native run or protected failure repair was performed. Physical admission remains HOLD.
